Enforcement_Rule: Every DB01 State_Code must resolve to LKP_States; no orphan communities
Notes: Foundation relationship — state list is fixed at 10 N-HYPPADEC states

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB01 LGA_Code must resolve to LKP_LGAs; LGA must belong to stated State_Code
Notes: LGA must be consistent with State_Code in same DB01 record

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB02 Community_ID must resolve to DB01; no orphan households
Notes: RESTRICTED — household data must not be published without aggregation

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB03 Community_ID must resolve to DB01; populated via SJ12 spatial join
Notes: Community_ID in DB03 assigned after spatial join — not manually entered in field

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB06 Community_ID must resolve to DB01; populated via SJ11 spatial join
Notes: Community_ID in DB06 assigned after spatial join

Cardinality: One-to-many (many observations per facility over time)
Enforcement_Rule: Every DB04 Hydro_ID must resolve to G07; no observation without registered facility
Notes: G07 must be built and QC-passed before DB04 observations can be validated

Cardinality: One-to-many (many observations per station over time)
Enforcement_Rule: Every DB05 Station_ID must resolve to G20; no observation without registered station
Notes: G20 must be built and QC-passed before DB05 observations can be validated

Enforcement_Rule: G03 point layer is the spatial representation of DB01; every DB01 record has a corresponding G03 point
Notes: G03 is derived from DB01 Latitude/Longitude; they must stay in sync

Enforcement_Rule: G26 is the spatial representation of DB03; every DB03 record has a corresponding G26 feature
Notes: G26 geometry type (point/line/polygon) determined at digitising stage

Enforcement_Rule: G19 is the spatial representation of DB06; every DB06 record has a corresponding G19 point
Notes: G19 derived from DB06 GPS coordinates

Cardinality: One-to-one (one reservoir per facility; cascade systems may have multiple — flag)
Enforcement_Rule: Every G08 Reservoir_ID must link to a G07 Hydro_ID; no orphan reservoir polygons
Notes: Cascade/multi-reservoir systems documented in Notes

Enforcement_Rule: G28 time-series layer links to G07 permanent facility
Notes: G28 is the spatial/temporal representation of DB04

Cardinality: Many-to-many (one erosion site may threaten multiple infrastructure; one infrastructure may be threatened by multiple sites)
Enforcement_Rule: Every Infrastructure_Threatened_ID value in DB03 must resolve to DB06 Infrastructure_ID
Join_Method: LEFT JOIN check after DB06 built
Notes: Populated after both DB03 and DB06 are CLEAN; cross-reference not a true FK — stored as comma-separated list

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB03 Erosion_Type must resolve to LKP_ErosionType.csv
Every DB03 Severity_0_4 must resolve to LKP_ErosionSeverity.csv
Notes: Same severity scale used in DB04 Erosion_Severity and DB06 Damage_Severity

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB06 Infrastructure_Type must resolve to LKP_InfrastructureType.csv
Notes: Critical_Service flag carried from lookup to DB06

Enforcement_Rule: Every DB04 Operating_Status must resolve to LKP_OperatingStatus.csv
Notes: Same lookup used in G07

Enforcement_Rule: Every non-null DB01 Livelihood must resolve to LKP_Livelihood.csv
Notes: Also used in DB02 Livelihood_Primary and Livelihood_Secondary

Enforcement_Rule: Every non-null DB01 Water_Source must resolve to LKP_WaterSource.csv
Notes: Also used in DB02 Water_Source

Enforcement_Rule: Every non-null DB01 Adaptation_Status must resolve to LKP_AdaptationStatus.csv
Notes: Also used in DB02 Adaptation_Measure

Enforcement_Rule: Every QC_Status must resolve to LKP_QC_Status.csv
Notes: Applied to all six databases

Enforcement_Rule: Community basin assignment added to DB01 after SJ03 spatial join
Notes: HYBAS_ID added to DB01 as derived field after G06 built and validated

Enforcement_Rule: Nearest river ID and distance added to DB01 after SJ04 spatial join
Notes: Populates DB01 Hydropower_Distance equivalent for river proximity (IND04)
